name: svhn_cropped_balanced
description: A balanced, cropped variant of the Street View House Numbers (SVHN) dataset for digit recognition. Measures image classification performance on natural, real-world digit crops with balanced class frequencies. Commonly used to evaluate convolutional models' accuracy and robustness on multi-digit street-number imagery.
reputation: Well-known, widely used benchmark in computer vision for digit recognition on real-world imagery.
